<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-email">Project email</h1>

This resource represents the email address used to send a project's notifications. Use it to get and set the [project's sender email address](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/dolKLg).

## Get project's sender email

<a id="opIdgetProjectEmail"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/0/email \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectId}/email`

Returns the [project's sender email address](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/dolKLg).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.

<h3 id="get-projects-sender-email-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectId|path|integer(int64)|true|The project ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"emailAddress\":\"jira@example.customdomain.com\",\"emailAddressStatus\":[\"Email address or domain not verified.\"]}"
```

<h3 id="get-projects-sender-email-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[ProjectEmailAddress](#schemaprojectemailaddress)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have permission to read project.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project or project's sender email address is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Set project's sender email

<a id="opIdupdateProjectEmail"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/0/email \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "emailAddress": "jira@example.atlassian.net"
  }'
```

`PUT /rest/api/3/project/{projectId}/email`

Sets the [project's sender email address](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/dolKLg).

If `emailAddress` is an empty string, the default email address is restored.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "emailAddress": "jira@example.atlassian.net"
}
```

<h3 id="set-projects-sender-email-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectId|path|integer(int64)|true|The project ID.|
|body|body|[ProjectEmailAddress](#schemaprojectemailaddress)|true|The project's sender email address to be set.|
|» emailAddress|body|string|false|The email address.|
|» emailAddressStatus|body|[string]|false|When using a custom domain, the status of the email address.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="set-projects-sender-email-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Returned if the project's sender email address is successfully set.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid, if the email address is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have permission to read project.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-features">Project features</h1>

This resource represents project features. Use it to get the list of features for a project and modify the state of a feature. The project feature endpoint is available only for Jira Software, both for team- and company-managed projects.

## Get project features

<a id="opIdgetFeaturesForProject"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/features \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/features`

Returns the list of features for a project.

<h3 id="get-project-features-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The ID or (case-sensitive) key of the project.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"features\":[{\"projectId\":10001,\"state\":\"ENABLED\",\"toggleLocked\":true,\"feature\":\"jsw.classic.roadmap\",\"prerequisites\":[],\"localisedName\":\"Roadmap\",\"localisedDescription\":\"Your roadmap is an optimized location to create and manage your epics.\",\"imageUri\":\"https://jira.atlassian.com/s/sb53l8/b/3/ab8a7691e4738b4f147e293f0864adfd5b8d3c85/_/download/resources/com.atlassian.jira.rest:classic-project-features/simple-roadmap-feature.svg\"},{\"projectId\":10001,\"state\":\"ENABLED\",\"toggleLocked\":true,\"feature\":\"jsw.classic.backlog\",\"prerequisites\":[],\"localisedName\":\"Backlog\",\"localisedDescription\":\"Plan and prioritize work in a dedicated space. To enable and configure the backlog for each board, go to board settings.\",\"imageUri\":\"https://jira.atlassian.com/s/sb53l8/b/3/ab8a7691e4738b4f147e293f0864adfd5b8d3c85/_/download/resources/com.atlassian.jira.rest:classic-project-features/simple-backlog-feature.svg\"}]}"
```

<h3 id="get-project-features-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[ContainerForProjectFeatures](#schemacontainerforprojectfeatures)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: read:jira-work )
</aside>

## Set project feature state

<a id="opIdtoggleFeatureForProject"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/features/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "state": "ENABLED"
  }'
```

`PUT /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/features/{featureKey}`

Sets the state of a project feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "state": "ENABLED"
}
```

<h3 id="set-project-feature-state-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The ID or (case-sensitive) key of the project.|
|featureKey|path|string|true|The key of the feature.|
|body|body|[ProjectFeatureState](#schemaprojectfeaturestate)|true|Details of the feature state change.|
|» state|body|string|false|The feature state.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» state|ENABLED|
|» state|DISABLED|
|» state|COMING_SOON|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"features\":[{\"projectId\":10001,\"state\":\"ENABLED\",\"toggleLocked\":true,\"feature\":\"jsw.classic.roadmap\",\"prerequisites\":[],\"localisedName\":\"Roadmap\",\"localisedDescription\":\"Your roadmap is an optimized location to create and manage your epics.\",\"imageUri\":\"https://jira.atlassian.com/s/sb53l8/b/3/ab8a7691e4738b4f147e293f0864adfd5b8d3c85/_/download/resources/com.atlassian.jira.rest:classic-project-features/simple-roadmap-feature.svg\"},{\"projectId\":10001,\"state\":\"ENABLED\",\"toggleLocked\":true,\"feature\":\"jsw.classic.backlog\",\"prerequisites\":[],\"localisedName\":\"Backlog\",\"localisedDescription\":\"Plan and prioritize work in a dedicated space. To enable and configure the backlog for each board, go to board settings.\",\"imageUri\":\"https://jira.atlassian.com/s/sb53l8/b/3/ab8a7691e4738b4f147e293f0864adfd5b8d3c85/_/download/resources/com.atlassian.jira.rest:classic-project-features/simple-backlog-feature.svg\"}]}"
```

<h3 id="set-project-feature-state-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[ContainerForProjectFeatures](#schemacontainerforprojectfeatures)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project or project feature is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-key-and-name-validation">Project key and name validation</h1>

This resource provides validation for project keys and names.

## Validate project key

<a id="opIdvalidateProjectKey"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/projectvalidate/key \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/projectvalidate/key`

Validates a project key by confirming the key is a valid string and not in use.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** None.

<h3 id="validate-project-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key|query|string|false|The project key.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"errorMessages\":[],\"errors\":{\"projectKey\":\"A project with that project key already exists.\"}}"
```

<h3 id="validate-project-key-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[ErrorCollection](#schemaerrorcollection)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: read:jira-work )
</aside>

## Get valid project key

<a id="opIdgetValidProjectKey"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/projectvalidate/validProjectKey \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/projectvalidate/validProjectKey`

Validates a project key and, if the key is invalid or in use, generates a valid random string for the project key.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** None.

<h3 id="get-valid-project-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key|query|string|false|The project key.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"\"VPNE\""
```

<h3 id="get-valid-project-key-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth
</aside>

## Get valid project name

<a id="opIdgetValidProjectName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/rest/api/3/projectvalidate/validProjectName?name=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/projectvalidate/validProjectName`

Checks that a project name isn't in use. If the name isn't in use, the passed string is returned. If the name is in use, this operation attempts to generate a valid project name based on the one supplied, usually by adding a sequence number. If a valid project name cannot be generated, a 404 response is returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** None.

<h3 id="get-valid-project-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|query|string|true|The project name.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"\"Valid Project Name Example\""
```

<h3 id="get-valid-project-name-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is invalid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if a valid project name cannot be generated.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth
</aside>

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-permission-schemes">Project permission schemes</h1>

This resource represents permission schemes for a project. Use this resource to:

 *  get details of a project's issue security levels available to the calling user.
 *  get the permission scheme associated with the project or assign different permission scheme to the project.
 *  get details of a project's issue security scheme.

See [Managing project permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for more information about permission schemes.

## Get project issue security scheme

<a id="opIdgetProjectIssueSecurityScheme"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/issuesecuritylevelscheme \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectKeyOrId}/issuesecuritylevelscheme`

Returns the [issue security scheme](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/J4lKLg) associated with the project.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or the *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg).

<h3 id="get-project-issue-security-scheme-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectKeyOrId|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/issuesecurityschemes/10000\",\"id\":10000,\"name\":\"Default Issue Security Scheme\",\"description\":\"Description for the default issue security scheme\",\"defaultSecurityLevelId\":10021,\"levels\":[{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/securitylevel/10021\",\"id\":\"10021\",\"description\":\"Only the reporter and internal staff can see this issue.\",\"name\":\"Reporter Only\"}]}"
```

<h3 id="get-project-issue-security-scheme-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[SecurityScheme](#schemasecurityscheme)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is invalid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the project is visible to the user but the user doesn't have administrative permissions.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project is not found or the user does not have permission to view it.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: read:jira-work )
</aside>

## Get assigned permission scheme

<a id="opIdgetAssignedPermissionScheme"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/permissionscheme \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectKeyOrId}/permissionscheme`

Gets the [permission scheme](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) associated with the project.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg).

<h3 id="get-assigned-permission-scheme-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectKeyOrId|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|
|expand|query|string|false|Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Note that permissions are included when you specify any value. Expand options include:<br><br> *  `all` Returns all expandable information.<br> *  `field` Returns information about the custom field granted the permission.<br> *  `group` Returns information about the group that is granted the permission.<br> *  `permissions` Returns all permission grants for each permission scheme.<br> *  `projectRole` Returns information about the project role granted the permission.<br> *  `user` Returns information about the user who is granted the permission.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"id\":10000,\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/permissionscheme/10000\",\"name\":\"Example permission scheme\",\"description\":\"description\"}"
```

<h3 id="get-assigned-permission-scheme-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[PermissionScheme](#schemapermissionscheme)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have permission to view the project's configuration.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project is not found or the user does not have permission to view the project.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: read:jira-work )
</aside>

## Assign permission scheme

<a id="opIdassignPermissionScheme"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/permissionscheme \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "id": 10000
  }'
```

`PUT /rest/api/3/project/{projectKeyOrId}/permissionscheme`

Assigns a permission scheme with a project. See [Managing project permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for more information about permission schemes.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg)

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "id": 10000
}
```

<h3 id="assign-permission-scheme-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectKeyOrId|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|
|expand|query|string|false|Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Note that permissions are included when you specify any value. Expand options include:<br><br> *  `all` Returns all expandable information.<br> *  `field` Returns information about the custom field granted the permission.<br> *  `group` Returns information about the group that is granted the permission.<br> *  `permissions` Returns all permission grants for each permission scheme.<br> *  `projectRole` Returns information about the project role granted the permission.<br> *  `user` Returns information about the user who is granted the permission.|
|body|body|[IdBean](#schemaidbean)|true|none|
|» id|body|integer(int64)|true|The ID of the permission scheme to associate with the project. Use the [Get all permission schemes](#api-rest-api-3-permissionscheme-get) resource to get a list of permission scheme IDs.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"id\":10000,\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/permissionscheme/10000\",\"name\":\"Example permission scheme\",\"description\":\"description\"}"
```

<h3 id="assign-permission-scheme-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[PermissionScheme](#schemapermissionscheme)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if:<br><br> *  the user does not have the necessary permission to edit the project's configuration.<br> *  the Jira instance is Jira Core Free or Jira Software Free. Permission schemes cannot be assigned to projects on free plans.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project or permission scheme is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Get project issue security levels

<a id="opIdgetSecurityLevelsForProject"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/securitylevel \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectKeyOrId}/securitylevel`

Returns all [issue security](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/J4lKLg) levels for the project that the user has access to.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse projects* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) for the project, however, issue security levels are only returned for authenticated user with *Set Issue Security* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) for the project.

<h3 id="get-project-issue-security-levels-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectKeyOrId|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"levels\":[{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/securitylevel/100000\",\"id\":\"100000\",\"description\":\"Only the reporter and internal staff can see this issue.\",\"name\":\"Reporter Only\"},{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/securitylevel/100001\",\"id\":\"100001\",\"description\":\"Only internal staff can see this issue.\",\"name\":\"Staff Only\"}]}"
```

<h3 id="get-project-issue-security-levels-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[ProjectIssueSecurityLevels](#schemaprojectissuesecuritylevels)|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project is not found or the user does not have permission to view it.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: read:jira-work )
</aside>

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-properties">Project properties</h1>

This resource represents [project](#api-group-Projects) properties, which provides for storing custom data against a project. Use it to get, create, and delete project properties as well as get a list of property keys for a project. Project properties are a type of [entity property](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/jira-entity-properties/).

## Get project property keys

<a id="opIdgetProjectPropertyKeys"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/properties \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/properties`

Returns all [project property](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/storing-data-without-a-database/#a-id-jira-entity-properties-a-jira-entity-properties) keys for the project.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.

<h3 id="get-project-property-keys-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"keys\":[{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/issue/EX-2/properties/issue.support\",\"key\":\"issue.support\"}]}"
```

<h3 id="get-project-property-keys-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[PropertyKeys](#schemapropertykeys)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have permission to view the project.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: read:jira-work )
</aside>

## Get project property

<a id="opIdgetProjectProperty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/properties/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/properties/{propertyKey}`

Returns the value of a [project property](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/storing-data-without-a-database/#a-id-jira-entity-properties-a-jira-entity-properties).

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project containing the property.

<h3 id="get-project-property-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|
|propertyKey|path|string|true|The project property key. Use [Get project property keys](#api-rest-api-3-project-projectIdOrKey-properties-get) to get a list of all project property keys.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"key\":\"issue.support\",\"value\":{\"system.conversation.id\":\"b1bf38be-5e94-4b40-a3b8-9278735ee1e6\",\"system.support.time\":\"1m\"}}"
```

<h3 id="get-project-property-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[EntityProperty](#schemaentityproperty)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have permission to view the project.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project or property is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: read:jira-work )
</aside>

## Set project property

<a id="opIdsetProjectProperty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/properties/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "number": 5,
    "string": "string-value"
  }'
```

`PUT /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/properties/{propertyKey}`

Sets the value of the [project property](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/storing-data-without-a-database/#a-id-jira-entity-properties-a-jira-entity-properties). You can use project properties to store custom data against the project.

The value of the request body must be a [valid](http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4627), non-empty JSON blob. The maximum length is 32768 characters.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project in which the property is created.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "number": 5,
  "string": "string-value"
}
```

<h3 id="set-project-property-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|
|propertyKey|path|string|true|The key of the project property. The maximum length is 255 characters.|
|body|body|object|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
null
```

> 201 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="set-project-property-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the project property is updated.|Inline|
|201|Created|Returned if the project property is created.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the project key or id is invalid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have permission to administer the project.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Delete project property

<a id="opIddeleteProjectProperty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/properties/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/properties/{propertyKey}`

Deletes the [property](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/storing-data-without-a-database/#a-id-jira-entity-properties-a-jira-entity-properties) from a project.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project containing the property.

<h3 id="delete-project-property-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-roles">Project roles</h1>

This resource represents the roles that users can play in projects. Use this resource to get, create, update, and delete project roles.

## Get project roles for project

<a id="opIdgetProjectRoles"></a>

> Code samples


Returns a list of [project roles](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/3odKLg) for the project returning the name and self URL for each role.

Note that all project roles are shared with all projects in Jira Cloud. See [Get all project roles](#api-rest-api-3-role-get) for more information.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

## Get all project roles

<a id="opIdgetAllProjectRoles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/role \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/role`

Gets a list of all project roles, complete with project role details and default actors.

### About project roles ###

[Project roles](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/3odKLg) are a flexible way to to associate users and groups with projects. In Jira Cloud, the list of project roles is shared globally with all projects, but each project can have a different set of actors associated with it (unlike groups, which have the same membership throughout all Jira applications).

Project roles are used in [permission schemes](#api-rest-api-3-permissionscheme-get), [email notification schemes](#api-rest-api-3-notificationscheme-get), [issue security levels](#api-rest-api-3-issuesecurityschemes-get), [comment visibility](#api-rest-api-3-comment-list-post), and workflow conditions.

#### Members and actors ####

In the Jira REST API, a member of a project role is called an *actor*. An *actor* is a group or user associated with a project role.

Actors may be set as [default members](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/3odKLg#Managingprojectroles-Specifying'defaultmembers'foraprojectrole) of the project role or set at the project level:

 *  Default actors: Users and groups that are assigned to the project role for all newly created projects. The default actors can be removed at the project level later if desired.
 *  Actors: Users and groups that are associated with a project role for a project, which may differ from the default actors. This enables you to assign a user to different roles in different projects.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"[{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/project/MKY/role/10360\",\"name\":\"Developers\",\"id\":10360,\"description\":\"A project role that represents developers in a project\",\"actors\":[{\"id\":10240,\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"type\":\"atlassian-group-role-actor\",\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"actorGroup\":{\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"groupId\":\"952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2\"}},{\"id\":10241,\"displayName\":\"Mia Krystof\",\"type\":\"atlassian-user-role-actor\",\"actorUser\":{\"accountId\":\"5b10a2844c20165700ede21g\"}}],\"scope\":{\"type\":\"PROJECT\",\"project\":{\"id\":\"10000\",\"key\":\"KEY\",\"name\":\"Next Gen Project\"}}}]"
```

<h3 id="get-all-project-roles-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have administrative permissions.|None|

<h3 id="get-all-project-roles-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[ProjectRole](#schemaprojectrole)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-configuration )
</aside>

## Create project role

<a id="opIdcreateProjectRole"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/role \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "A project role that represents developers in a project",
    "name": "Developers"
  }'
```

`POST /rest/api/3/role`

Creates a new project role with no [default actors](#api-rest-api-3-resolution-get). You can use the [Add default actors to project role](#api-rest-api-3-role-id-actors-post) operation to add default actors to the project role after creating it.

*Note that although a new project role is available to all projects upon creation, any default actors that are associated with the project role are not added to projects that existed prior to the role being created.*<

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "A project role that represents developers in a project",
  "name": "Developers"
}
```

<h3 id="create-project-role-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateUpdateRoleRequestBean](#schemacreateupdaterolerequestbean)|true|none|
|» description|body|string|false|A description of the project role. Required when fully updating a project role. Optional when creating or partially updating a project role.|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the project role. Must be unique. Cannot begin or end with whitespace. The maximum length is 255 characters. Required when creating a project role. Optional when partially updating a project role.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/project/MKY/role/10360\",\"name\":\"Developers\",\"id\":10360,\"description\":\"A project role that represents developers in a project\"}"
```

<h3 id="create-project-role-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[ProjectRole](#schemaprojectrole)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid. The `name` cannot be empty or start or end with whitespace.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have administrative permissions.|None|
|409|Conflict|Returned if a project role with the provided name already exists.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-configuration )
</aside>

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-role-actors">Project role actors</h1>

This resource represents the users assigned to [project roles](#api-group-Issue-comments). Use it to get, add, and remove default users from project roles. Also use it to add and remove users from a project role associated with a project.

## Set actors for project role

<a id="opIdsetActors"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/role/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "categorisedActors": {
      "atlassian-group-role-actor-id": [
        "952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2"
      ],
      "atlassian-user-role-actor": [
        "12345678-9abc-def1-2345-6789abcdef12"
      ]
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/role/{id}`

Sets the actors for a project role for a project, replacing all existing actors.

To add actors to the project without overwriting the existing list, use [Add actors to project role](#api-rest-api-3-project-projectIdOrKey-role-id-post).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project or *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "categorisedActors": {
    "atlassian-group-role-actor-id": [
      "952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2"
    ],
    "atlassian-user-role-actor": [
      "12345678-9abc-def1-2345-6789abcdef12"
    ]
  }
}
```

<h3 id="set-actors-for-project-role-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|
|id|path|integer(int64)|true|The ID of the project role. Use [Get all project roles](#api-rest-api-3-role-get) to get a list of project role IDs.|
|body|body|[ProjectRoleActorsUpdateBean](#schemaprojectroleactorsupdatebean)|true|The groups or users to associate with the project role for this project. Provide the user account ID, group name, or group ID. As a group's name can change, use of group ID is recommended.|
|» categorisedActors|body|object|false|The actors to add to the project role.<br><br>Add groups using:<br><br> *  `atlassian-group-role-actor` and a list of group names.<br> *  `atlassian-group-role-actor-id` and a list of group IDs.<br><br>As a group's name can change, use of `atlassian-group-role-actor-id` is recommended. For example, `"atlassian-group-role-actor-id":["eef79f81-0b89-4fca-a736-4be531a10869","77f6ab39-e755-4570-a6ae-2d7a8df0bcb8"]`.<br><br>Add users using `atlassian-user-role-actor` and a list of account IDs. For example, `"atlassian-user-role-actor":["12345678-9abc-def1-2345-6789abcdef12", "abcdef12-3456-789a-bcde-f123456789ab"]`.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[string]|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/project/MKY/role/10360\",\"name\":\"Developers\",\"id\":10360,\"description\":\"A project role that represents developers in a project\",\"actors\":[{\"id\":10240,\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"type\":\"atlassian-group-role-actor\",\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"actorGroup\":{\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"groupId\":\"952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2\"}},{\"id\":10241,\"displayName\":\"Mia Krystof\",\"type\":\"atlassian-user-role-actor\",\"actorUser\":{\"accountId\":\"5b10a2844c20165700ede21g\"}}],\"scope\":{\"type\":\"PROJECT\",\"project\":{\"id\":\"10000\",\"key\":\"KEY\",\"name\":\"Next Gen Project\"}}}"
```

<h3 id="set-actors-for-project-role-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful. The complete list of actors for the project is returned.|[ProjectRole](#schemaprojectrole)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing or if the calling user lacks administrative permissions for the project.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if:<br><br> *  the project is not found.<br> *  a user or group is not found.<br> *  a group or user is not active.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Add actors to project role

<a id="opIdaddActorUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/role/0 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "groupId": [
      "952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/role/{id}`

Adds actors to a project role for the project.

To replace all actors for the project, use [Set actors for project role](#api-rest-api-3-project-projectIdOrKey-role-id-put).

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project or *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "groupId": [
    "952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-actors-to-project-role-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|
|id|path|integer(int64)|true|The ID of the project role. Use [Get all project roles](#api-rest-api-3-role-get) to get a list of project role IDs.|
|body|body|[ActorsMap](#schemaactorsmap)|true|The groups or users to associate with the project role for this project. Provide the user account ID, group name, or group ID. As a group's name can change, use of group ID is recommended.|
|» group|body|[string]|false|The name of the group to add. This parameter cannot be used with the `groupId` parameter. As a group's name can change, use of `groupId` is recommended.|
|» groupId|body|[string]|false|The ID of the group to add. This parameter cannot be used with the `group` parameter.|
|» user|body|[string]|false|The user account ID of the user to add.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/project/MKY/role/10360\",\"name\":\"Developers\",\"id\":10360,\"description\":\"A project role that represents developers in a project\",\"actors\":[{\"id\":10240,\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"type\":\"atlassian-group-role-actor\",\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"actorGroup\":{\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"groupId\":\"952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2\"}},{\"id\":10241,\"displayName\":\"Mia Krystof\",\"type\":\"atlassian-user-role-actor\",\"actorUser\":{\"accountId\":\"5b10a2844c20165700ede21g\"}}],\"scope\":{\"type\":\"PROJECT\",\"project\":{\"id\":\"10000\",\"key\":\"KEY\",\"name\":\"Next Gen Project\"}}}"
```

<h3 id="add-actors-to-project-role-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful. The complete list of actors for the project is returned.<br><br>For example, the cURL request above adds a group, *jira-developers*. For the response below to be returned as a result of that request, the user *Mia Krystof* would have previously been added as a `user` actor for this project.|[ProjectRole](#schemaprojectrole)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing or if the calling user lacks administrative permissions for the project.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if:<br><br> *  the project is not found.<br> *  the user or group is not found.<br> *  the group or user is not active.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-configuration )
</aside>

## Add default actors to project role

<a id="opIdaddProjectRoleActorsToRole"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/role/0/actors \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "user": [
      "admin"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /rest/api/3/role/{id}/actors`

Adds [default actors](#api-rest-api-3-resolution-get) to a role. You may add groups or users, but you cannot add groups and users in the same request.

Changing a project role's default actors does not affect project role members for projects already created.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "user": [
    "admin"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-default-actors-to-project-role-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer(int64)|true|The ID of the project role. Use [Get all project roles](#api-rest-api-3-role-get) to get a list of project role IDs.|
|body|body|[ActorInputBean](#schemaactorinputbean)|true|none|
|» group|body|[string]|false|The name of the group to add as a default actor. This parameter cannot be used with the `groupId` parameter. As a group's name can change,use of `groupId` is recommended. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. For example, `"group":["project-admin", "jira-developers"]`.|
|» groupId|body|[string]|false|The ID of the group to add as a default actor. This parameter cannot be used with the `group` parameter This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. For example, `"groupId":["77f6ab39-e755-4570-a6ae-2d7a8df0bcb8", "0c011f85-69ed-49c4-a801-3b18d0f771bc"]`.|
|» user|body|[string]|false|The account IDs of the users to add as default actors. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. For example, `"user":["5b10a2844c20165700ede21g", "5b109f2e9729b51b54dc274d"]`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"actors\":[{\"id\":10240,\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"type\":\"atlassian-group-role-actor\",\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"actorGroup\":{\"name\":\"jira-developers\",\"displayName\":\"jira-developers\",\"groupId\":\"952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2\"}}]}"
```

<h3 id="add-default-actors-to-project-role-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[ProjectRole](#schemaprojectrole)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is invalid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have administrative permissions.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the project role is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-configuration )
</aside>

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-project-versions">Project versions</h1>

This resource represents project versions. Use it to get, get lists of, create, update, move, merge, and delete project versions. This resource also provides counts of issues by version.

## Get project versions paginated

<a id="opIdgetProjectVersionsPaginated"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/project/string/version \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/version`

Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of all versions in a project. See the [Get project versions](#api-rest-api-3-project-projectIdOrKey-versions-get) resource if you want to get a full list of versions without pagination.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.

<h3 id="get-project-versions-paginated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectIdOrKey|path|string|true|The project ID or project key (case sensitive).|
|startAt|query|integer(int64)|false|The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).|
|maxResults|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|orderBy|query|string|false|[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:<br><br> *  `description` Sorts by version description.<br> *  `name` Sorts by version name.<br> *  `releaseDate` Sorts by release date, starting with the oldest date. Versions with no release date are listed last.<br> *  `sequence` Sorts by the order of appearance in the user interface.<br> *  `startDate` Sorts by start date, starting with the oldest date. Versions with no start date are listed last.|
|query|query|string|false|Filter the results using a literal string. Versions with matching `name` or `description` are returned (case insensitive).|
|status|query|string|false|A list of status values used to filter the results by version status. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. The status values are `released`, `unreleased`, and `archived`.|
|expand|query|string|false|Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Expand options include:<br><br> *  `issuesstatus` Returns the number of issues in each status category for each version.<br> *  `operations` Returns actions that can be performed on the specified version.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderBy|description|
|orderBy|-description|
|orderBy|+description|
|orderBy|name|
|orderBy|-name|
|orderBy|+name|
|orderBy|releaseDate|
|orderBy|-releaseDate|
|orderBy|+releaseDate|
|orderBy|sequence|
|orderBy|-sequence|
|orderBy|+sequence|
|orderBy|startDate|
|orderBy|-startDate|
|orderBy|+startDate|

## Create version

<a id="opIdcreateVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/version \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "archived": false,
    "description": "An excellent version",
    "name": "New Version 1",
    "projectId": 10000,
    "releaseDate": "2010-07-06",
    "released": true
  }'
```

`POST /rest/api/3/version`

Creates a project version.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project the version is added to.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "archived": false,
  "description": "An excellent version",
  "name": "New Version 1",
  "projectId": 10000,
  "releaseDate": "2010-07-06",
  "released": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[Version](#schemaversion)|true|none|
|» archived|body|boolean|false|Indicates that the version is archived. Optional when creating or updating a version.|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the version. Optional when creating or updating a version.|
|» expand|body|string|false|Use [expand](em>#expansion) to include additional information about version in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Expand options include:<br><br> *  `operations` Returns the list of operations available for this version.<br> *  `issuesstatus` Returns the count of issues in this version for each of the status categories *to do*, *in progress*, *done*, and *unmapped*. The *unmapped* property contains a count of issues with a status other than *to do*, *in progress*, and *done*.<br><br>Optional for create and update.|
|» moveUnfixedIssuesTo|body|string(uri)|false|The URL of the self link to the version to which all unfixed issues are moved when a version is released. Not applicable when creating a version. Optional when updating a version.|
|» name|body|string|false|The unique name of the version. Required when creating a version. Optional when updating a version. The maximum length is 255 characters.|
|» project|body|string|false|Deprecated. Use `projectId`.|
|» projectId|body|integer(int64)|false|The ID of the project to which this version is attached. Required when creating a version. Not applicable when updating a version.|
|» releaseDate|body|string(date)|false|The release date of the version. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd). Optional when creating or updating a version.|
|» released|body|boolean|false|Indicates that the version is released. If the version is released a request to release again is ignored. Not applicable when creating a version. Optional when updating a version.|
|» startDate|body|string(date)|false|The start date of the version. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd). Optional when creating or updating a version.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/version/10000\",\"id\":\"10000\",\"description\":\"An excellent version\",\"name\":\"New Version 1\",\"archived\":false,\"released\":true,\"releaseDate\":\"2010-07-06\",\"userReleaseDate\":\"6/Jul/2010\",\"project\":\"PXA\",\"projectId\":10000}"
```

<h3 id="create-version-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Returned if the request is successful.|[Version](#schemaversion)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is invalid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if:<br><br> *  the project is not found.<br> *  the user does not have the required permissions.|None|

Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Delete version

<a id="opIddeleteVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/version/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /rest/api/3/version/{id}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Deletes a project version.

Deprecated, use [ Delete and replace version](#api-rest-api-3-version-id-removeAndSwap-post) that supports swapping version values in custom fields, in addition to the swapping for `fixVersion` and `affectedVersion` provided in this resource.

Alternative versions can be provided to update issues that use the deleted version in `fixVersion` or `affectedVersion`. If alternatives are not provided, occurrences of `fixVersion` and `affectedVersion` that contain the deleted version are cleared.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project that contains the version.

<h3 id="delete-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The ID of the version.|
|moveFixIssuesTo|query|string|false|The ID of the version to update `fixVersion` to when the field contains the deleted version. The replacement version must be in the same project as the version being deleted and cannot be the version being deleted.|
|moveAffectedIssuesTo|query|string|false|The ID of the version to update `affectedVersion` to when the field contains the deleted version. The replacement version must be in the same project as the version being deleted and cannot be the version being deleted.|

<h3 id="delete-version-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Returned if the version is deleted.|None|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is invalid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if:<br><br> *  the authentication credentials are incorrect.<br> *  the user does not have the required permissions.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the version is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Merge versions

<a id="opIdmergeVersions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/version/string/mergeto/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`PUT /rest/api/3/version/{id}/mergeto/{moveIssuesTo}`

Merges two project versions. The merge is completed by deleting the version specified in `id` and replacing any occurrences of its ID in `fixVersion` with the version ID specified in `moveIssuesTo`.

Consider using [ Delete and replace version](#api-rest-api-3-version-id-removeAndSwap-post) instead. This resource supports swapping version values in `fixVersion`, `affectedVersion`, and custom fields.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project that contains the version.

<h3 id="merge-versions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The ID of the version to delete.|
|moveIssuesTo|path|string|true|The ID of the version to merge into.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="merge-versions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Returned if the version is deleted.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is invalid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if:<br><br> *  the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.<br> *  the user does not have the required permissions.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the version to be deleted or the version to merge to are not found.|None|

basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Delete and replace version

<a id="opIddeleteAndReplaceVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/version/string/removeAndSwap \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "customFieldReplacementList": [
      {
        "customFieldId": 0,
        "moveTo": 0
      }
    ],

    "moveFixIssuesTo": 0
  }'
```

`POST /rest/api/3/version/{id}/removeAndSwap`

Deletes a project version.

Alternative versions can be provided to update issues that use the deleted version in `fixVersion`, `affectedVersion`, or any version picker custom fields. If alternatives are not provided, occurrences of `fixVersion`, `affectedVersion`, and any version picker custom field, that contain the deleted version, are cleared. Any replacement version must be in the same project as the version being deleted and cannot be the version being deleted.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project that contains the version.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customFieldReplacementList": [
    {
      "customFieldId": 0,
      "moveTo": 0
    }
  ],
  "moveAffectedIssuesTo": 0,
  "moveFixIssuesTo": 0
}
```

<h3 id="delete-and-replace-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The ID of the version.|
|body|body|[DeleteAndReplaceVersionBean](#schemadeleteandreplaceversionbean)|true|none|
|» customFieldReplacementList|body|[[CustomFieldReplacement](#schemacustomfieldreplacement)]|false|An array of custom field IDs (`customFieldId`) and version IDs (`moveTo`) to update when the fields contain the deleted version.|
|» moveAffectedIssuesTo|body|integer(int64)|false|The ID of the version to update `affectedVersion` to when the field contains the deleted version.|
|» moveFixIssuesTo|body|integer(int64)|false|The ID of the version to update `fixVersion` to when the field contains the deleted version.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response


<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-screens">Screens</h1>

This resource represents the screens used to record issue details. Use it to:

 *  get details of all screens.
 *  get details of all the fields available for use on screens.
 *  create screens.
 *  delete screens.
 *  update screens.
 *  add a field to the default screen.

## Get screens for a field

<a id="opIdgetScreensForField"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/field/string/screens \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/field/{fieldId}/screens`

Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of the screens a field is used in.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

<h3 id="get-screens-for-a-field-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fieldId|path|string|true|The ID of the field to return screens for.|
|startAt|query|integer(int64)|false|The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).|
|maxResults|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|expand|query|string|false|Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information about screens in the response. This parameter accepts `tab` which returns details about the screen tabs the field is used in.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"maxResults\":1,\"startAt\":0,\"total\":5,\"isLast\":false,\"values\":[{\"id\":10001,\"name\":\"Default Screen\",\"description\":\"Provides for the update of all system fields.\",\"tab\":{\"id\":10000,\"name\":\"Fields Tab\"}}]}"
```

<h3 id="get-screens-for-a-field-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[PageBeanScreenWithTab](#schemapagebeanscreenwithtab)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.|None|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Get screens

<a id="opIdgetScreens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/screens \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/screens`

Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of all screens or those specified by one or more screen IDs.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

<h3 id="get-screens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startAt|query|integer(int64)|false|The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).|
|maxResults|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|id|query|[integer(int64)]|false|The list of screen IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `id=10000&id=10001`.|
|queryString|query|string|false|String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with screen name.|
|scope|query|[string]|false|The scope filter string. To filter by multiple scope, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `scope=GLOBAL&scope=PROJECT`.|
|orderBy|query|string|false|[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:<br><br> *  `id` Sorts by screen ID.<br> *  `name` Sorts by screen name.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|scope|GLOBAL|
|scope|TEMPLATE|
|scope|PROJECT|
|orderBy|name|
|orderBy|-name|
|orderBy|+name|
|orderBy|id|
|orderBy|-id|
|orderBy|+id|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/screens\",\"maxResults\":100,\"startAt\":0,\"total\":3,\"isLast\":true,\"values\":[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Default Screen\",\"description\":\"Provides for the update all system fields.\"},{\"id\":2,\"name\":\"Workflow Screen\",\"description\":\"This screen is used in the workflow and enables you to assign issues.\"},{\"id\":3,\"name\":\"Resolve Issue Screen\",\"description\":\"Offers the ability to set resolution, change fix versions, and assign an issue.\"}]}"
```

<h3 id="get-screens-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[PageBeanScreen](#schemapagebeanscreen)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Create screen

<a id="opIdcreateScreen"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/screens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "Enables changes to resolution and linked issues.",
    "name": "Resolve Security Issue Screen"
  }'
```

`POST /rest/api/3/screens`

Creates a screen with a default field tab.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "Enables changes to resolution and linked issues.",
  "name": "Resolve Security Issue Screen"
}
```

<h3 id="create-screen-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ScreenDetails](#schemascreendetails)|true|none|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the screen. The maximum length is 255 characters.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the screen. The name must be unique. The maximum length is 255 characters.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
"{\"id\":10005,\"name\":\"Resolve Security Issue Screen\",\"description\":\"Enables changes to resolution and linked issues.\"}"
```

> 400 Response

```json
"{\"errorMessages\":[\"The name is used by another screen.\"],\"errors\":{}}"
```

> 403 Response

```json
"{\"errorMessages\":[\"Only Jira administrators can manage screens.\"],\"errors\":{}}"
```

<h3 id="create-screen-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Returned if the request is successful.|[Screen](#schemascreen)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.|None|

<aside class="warning">

basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-screen-schemes">Screen schemes</h1>

This resource represents screen schemes in classic projects. Use it to get, create, update, and delete screen schemes.

## Get screen schemes

<a id="opIdgetScreenSchemes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/screenscheme \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/screenscheme`

Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of screen schemes.

Only screen schemes used in classic projects are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

<h3 id="get-screen-schemes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startAt|query|integer(int64)|false|The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).|
|maxResults|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of items to return per page.|
|id|query|[integer(int64)]|false|The list of screen scheme IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `id=10000&id=10001`.|
|expand|query|string|false|Use [expand](#expansion) include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts `issueTypeScreenSchemes` that, for each screen schemes, returns information about the issue type screen scheme the screen scheme is assigned to.|
|queryString|query|string|false|String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with screen scheme name.|
|orderBy|query|string|false|[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:<br><br> *  `id` Sorts by screen scheme ID.<br> *  `name` Sorts by screen scheme name.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderBy|name|
|orderBy|-name|
|orderBy|+name|
|orderBy|id|
|orderBy|-id|
|orderBy|+id|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/screenscheme?maxResults=25&startAt=0\",\"maxResults\":100,\"startAt\":0,\"total\":2,\"isLast\":true,\"values\":[{\"id\":10010,\"name\":\"Employee screen scheme\",\"description\":\"Manage employee data\",\"screens\":{\"default\":10017,\"edit\":10019,\"create\":10019,\"view\":10020},\"issueTypeScreenSchemes\":{\"maxResults\":100,\"startAt\":0,\"total\":1,\"isLast\":true,\"values\":[{\"id\":\"10000\",\"name\":\"Office issue type screen scheme\",\"description\":\"Managing office projects\"}]}},{\"id\":10032,\"name\":\"Office screen scheme\",\"description\":\"Manage office data\",\"screens\":{\"default\":10020}}]}"
```

<h3 id="get-screen-schemes-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[PageBeanScreenScheme](#schemapagebeanscreenscheme)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-project )
</aside>

## Create screen scheme

<a id="opIdcreateScreenScheme"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/screenscheme \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "Manage employee data",
    "name": "Employee screen scheme",
    "screens": {
      "default": 10017,
      "edit": 10019,
      "view": 10020
    }
  }'
```

`POST /rest/api/3/screenscheme`

Creates a screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "Manage employee data",
  "name": "Employee screen scheme",
  "screens": {
    "default": 10017,
    "edit": 10019,
    "view": 10020
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-screen-scheme-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ScreenSchemeDetails](#schemascreenschemedetails)|true|none|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the screen scheme. The maximum length is 255 characters.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the screen scheme. The name must be unique. The maximum length is 255 characters.|
|» screens|body|object|true|The IDs of the screens for the screen types of the screen scheme. Only screens used in classic projects are accepted.|
|» » create|body|integer(int64)|false|The ID of the create screen.|
|» » default|body|integer(int64)|false|The ID of the default screen. Required when creating a screen scheme.|
|» » edit|body|integer(int64)|false|The ID of the edit screen.|
|» » view|body|integer(int64)|false|The ID of the view screen.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
"{\"id\":10001}"
```

> 400 Response

```json
"{\"errorMessages\":[\"The name is used by another scheme.\"],\"errors\":{}}"
```

> 403 Response

```json
"{\"errorMessages\":[\"Only Jira administrators can access screen schemes.\"],\"errors\":{}}"
```

> 404 Response

```json
"{\"errorMessages\":[\"One or more screens assigned to screen types was not found.\"],\"errors\":{}}"
```

<h3 id="create-screen-scheme-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Returned if the request is successful.|[ScreenSchemeId](#schemascreenschemeid)|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the request is not valid.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if a screen used as one of the screen types in the screen scheme is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-configuration )
</aside>

```json
{
```

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-tasks">Tasks</h1>

This resource represents a [long-running asynchronous tasks](#async-operations). Use it to obtain details about the progress of a long-running task or cancel a long-running task.

## Get task

<a id="opIdgetTask"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/task/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/task/{taskId}`

Returns the status of a [long-running asynchronous task](#async).

When a task has finished, this operation returns the JSON blob applicable to the task. See the documentation of the operation that created the task for details. Task details are not permanently retained. As of September 2019, details are retained for 14 days although this period may change without notice.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** either of:

 *  *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).
 *  Creator of the task.

<h3 id="get-task-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|taskId|path|string|true|The ID of the task.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"self\":\"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/task/1\",\"id\":\"1\",\"description\":\"Task description\",\"status\":\"COMPLETE\",\"result\":\"the task result, this may be any JSON\",\"submittedBy\":10000,\"progress\":100,\"elapsedRuntime\":156,\"submitted\":1677577514805,\"started\":1677577514905,\"finished\":1677577515006,\"lastUpdate\":1677577515006}"
```

<h3 id="get-task-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful.|[TaskProgressBeanObject](#schemataskprogressbeanobject)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.|None|
|404|Not Found|Returned if the task is not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2
</aside>

<h1 id="the-jira-cloud-platform-rest-api-time-tracking">Time tracking</h1>

This resource represents time tracking and time tracking providers. Use it to get and set the time tracking provider, get and set the time tracking options, and disable time tracking.

## Get selected time tracking provider

<a id="opIdgetSelectedTimeTrackingImplementation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rest/api/3/configuration/timetracking \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /rest/api/3/configuration/timetracking`

Returns the time tracking provider that is currently selected. Note that if time tracking is disabled, then a successful but empty response is returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\"key\":\"Jira\",\"name\":\"JIRA provided time tracking\",\"url\":\"/example/config/url\"}"
```

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="get-selected-time-tracking-provider-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returned if the request is successful and time tracking is enabled.|[TimeTrackingProvider](#schematimetrackingprovider)|
|204|No Content|Returned if the request is successful but time tracking is disabled.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, OAuth2 ( Scopes: manage:jira-configuration )
</aside>

```bash
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "Jira"
  }'
```

`PUT /rest/api/3/configuration/timetracking`

Selects a time tracking provider.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

```json
  "key": "Jira"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[TimeTrackingProvider](#schematimetrackingprovider)|true|none|
|» key|body|string|true|The key for the time tracking provider. For example, *JIRA*.|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the time tracking provider. For example, *JIRA provided time tracking*.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Returned if the request is successful.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Returned if the time tracking provider is not found.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.|None|
